esc_unavailable.title: Not available
esc_unavailable.body: The game has this button, but Vanilla Agents has nothing behind it yet.

esc_project_add.title: Add project
esc_project_add.body: Type the folder of a git project above, then click here. The program finds out what kind of project it is, sets up its own checks and a private trusted folder for it, and opens it.
esc_project_add.use: Needs a folder that already has git saves.

route_fast.title: Fast route
route_fast.body: The change was small and did not touch the checker or its tests, so only the quick checks ran. The hidden checks were skipped on purpose.
route_fast.use: Press Verify now again after a bigger change to get the full route.

route_full.title: Full route
route_full.body: Every check ran, including the hidden ones. This route is used for big changes, build files, the checker's own code, or whenever the program is unsure.
route_full.use: Nothing to do; this is the careful route.

aura_approved.title: Plan approved
aura_approved.body: A buff. You looked at the plan for this quest and said yes before the work counted.
aura_approved.use: Nothing to do; it is on record in the chat log.

quest_approve.title: Approve plan
quest_approve.body: Click to record that you agree with this quest's plan. It goes in the chat log and stays after a restart.

quest_tier_yes.title: Yes
quest_tier_yes.body: You agree. The quest goes ahead and the decision is written in the chat log.

quest_tier_change.title: Change it
quest_tier_change.body: You want this quest done differently. It goes back to needing your yes, and a Claude session is asked to change it.
quest_tier_change.use: Click, then tell the Claude session what to change.

quest_tier_explain.title: Explain it more
quest_tier_explain.body: Not clear yet? A note goes to the chat log. The next Claude session you start will see it and answer under the quest.

quest_tier_never.title: Never done by itself
quest_tier_never.body: Sending work out, publishing, spending real money and deleting outside the project are never approved automatically. It is a label and a gate on the automatic yes, not a lock on what a helper can do: only you decide.
quest_tier_never.use: Click Yes only if you really want it.

quest_tier_auto.title: Auto-approved
quest_tier_auto.body: Small, low risk and inside the plan, so it went ahead without asking. It is on record in the chat log.
quest_tier_auto.use: Press Undo the yes any time until the quest is done.

quest_tier_veto.title: Undo the yes
quest_tier_veto.body: Takes back the automatic yes. This works until the quest is done; work a helper already started is not stopped by this button.

aura_auto.title: Auto-approved
aura_auto.body: A buff. Small, low-risk quests went ahead on their own because they are inside the plan you approved. The number is how many.
aura_auto.use: Open the Quest Log (L) to undo one.

quest_approved.title: Plan approved
quest_approved.body: You approved this quest's plan. It is on record in the chat log.

quest_sent_back.title: Sent back
quest_sent_back.body: The checker did not accept this work and sent it back. This is the evidence it found: the test that failed and what it saw. Hidden checks never show their details.
quest_sent_back.use: Fix the work, then press Verify now again.

player.title: The Controller
player.body: This is vanilla-agents itself. It hands out jobs and checks that the work is really finished.

health.title: Quests done
health.body: How many jobs the checker has confirmed are really done, out of all the jobs it knows about.
health.use: Fills up as more quests are completed.

mana.title: Mana
mana.body: How much of your usage allowance is already spent. When it runs out, work waits until it refills.
mana.use: The number on the bar is the part already used.

target.title: Target
target.body: The helper you are looking at right now. Click a helper in the workshop to target it.

quest_new.title: A new quest
quest_new.body: A new job that nobody has started yet.
quest_new.use: The gold ! means it is waiting for a helper.

quest_progress.title: Quest in progress
quest_progress.body: A helper is working on this job right now.

quest_ready.title: Ready to hand in
quest_ready.body: The helper says it is finished. Now the checker looks at it to be sure.
quest_ready.use: The gold ? means it is ready for checking.

quest_done.title: Quest complete
quest_done.body: The checker looked at the work and confirmed it really is done.

quest_failed.title: Quest failed
quest_failed.body: The checker looked at the work and it was not good enough. A helper will have to try again.

quest_blocked.title: Out of range
quest_blocked.body: This job is stuck and waiting for something, often for you to say yes.

objective.title: Objective
objective.body: One thing the checker must see before it believes the job is done. A check mark means it saw it.
objective.use: Green check = passed. Red cross = failed. Grey dot = not checked yet.

portrait.title: Helper portrait
portrait.body: This helper's hero in the inn. Click a hero in the inn, or a raid frame, to look at another one.

pass_rate.title: Pass rate
pass_rate.body: Out of the jobs this helper finished, how many the checker accepted.

tools.title: Tools used
tools.body: The things this helper has used so far, like reading or changing files. The number is how many times.

chat.title: Chat window
chat.body: A running diary of everything that happens, written in plain words. System messages are yellow, helpers are blue, the checker is orange.

verify.title: Verify now
verify.body: Asks the checker to run the real tests on your game code right now and tell you if the work is really finished. It takes a while (about 15 minutes for the full test).
verify.use: Click or press 1 (or V). A yellow bar fills while it checks.

pause.title: Pause
pause.body: Puts the checker on hold so Verify now refuses to start until you resume. Anything already running finishes by itself.
pause.use: Click or press 2 (or Z). Press again to resume.

resume.title: Resume
resume.body: Takes the checker off hold so Verify now works again.

cast.title: Checking
cast.body: The checker is running a test. The bar shows roughly how far along it is; the real end time can differ.

agent.title: A helper
agent.body: One helper sitting at its desk. Click it to see its character sheet.
agent.use: Typing means it is working. Resting means it is waiting.

spell_default.title: A check
spell_default.body: One thing the checker can test about your project. Each check says yes or no.

spell_cargo_test.title: Run the game's tests
spell_cargo_test.body: Runs every automatic test in the game code. If they all pass, the code still does what it did before.
spell_cargo_test.use: Click to run Verify now. It takes about 15 minutes.

item_empty.title: Empty slot
item_empty.body: Nothing here yet. Finished reports and changed files fill the bag.

raid_frame.title: Helper frame
raid_frame.body: One small frame for each helper. The bar shows how many of its quests the checker has passed. Little icons show what is true right now.
raid_frame.use: Click a frame to look at that helper.

talent_tab.title: Talent trees
talent_tab.body: Tools: what this helper used, one rank per use (5 at most). Trust: what it may do without asking you, from the tiers of its quests. Results: what the checker said about its work.

talent_tool.title: Tool talent
talent_tool.body: Each use of this tool is one rank. The tree shows at most 5 ranks.

talent_never.title: Never by itself
talent_never.body: Quests of this helper that touch something sensitive. They never start without your own click.

talent_ask.title: Asks you first
talent_ask.body: Quests of this helper that wait for your yes before they count.

talent_auto.title: Starts by itself
talent_auto.body: Quests of this helper that are in the approved plan, small and low risk, so they start without asking.

talent_yours.title: You said yes
talent_yours.body: Quests of this helper you approved yourself.

talent_passed.title: Quests passed
talent_passed.body: Quests of this helper the checker confirmed as really done.

talent_failed.title: Quests failed
talent_failed.body: Quests of this helper the checker sent back.

talent_checks.title: Checks passed
talent_checks.body: Hidden checks that passed on the quests this helper handed in last.

talent_ready.title: Waiting for you
talent_ready.body: Quests of this helper that are ready to hand in and wait for your approval.

talent_footer.title: Respec
talent_footer.body: This window only shows what happened. What a helper may do without asking is set by Claude's own permissions, changed in Claude itself, not here.

flight_point.title: Flight point
flight_point.use: Click to fly there (open this project).

flight_here.title: You are here
flight_here.body: The project that is open now.

auction_tab.title: Bounty Board
auction_tab.body: Bounties: new quests no helper has taken yet. Taken: quests a helper is on, and who.

auction_row.title: Bounty
auction_row.body: Colour shows the size: grey unknown, green small, blue medium, purple big. Risk says whether it touches something sensitive.

auction_post.title: Post a bounty
auction_post.body: Adds a new quest with your title and the reason in plain words. A helper can take it from the board.

loot_need.title: Need (Approve)
loot_need.body: Approve this quest: you are happy with what was handed in.

loot_greed.title: Greed (Change)
loot_greed.body: Ask for a change: write a short note and the helper gets it.

loot_pass.title: Pass
loot_pass.body: Hide this roll until the window is reloaded. Nothing is decided; the quest stays in the quest log.

loot_timer.title: Roll timer
loot_timer.body: The roll hides by itself when the bar runs out. Nothing is decided automatically.

raid_group.title: Same quest
raid_group.body: These helpers are working on the same quest.

aura_running.title: Running
aura_running.body: A buff. This is working right now.
aura_running.use: It goes away when the work stops.

aura_paused.title: On hold
aura_paused.body: A debuff. Checking is paused, so finished work waits.
aura_paused.use: Press Resume on the action bar to let checks run again.

aura_failed.title: Failed
aura_failed.body: A debuff. The checker looked at the work and it did not pass. The number is how many quests failed.
aura_failed.use: Open the Quest Log (L) to see which one.

aura_blocked.title: Stuck
aura_blocked.body: A debuff. A quest cannot go on, so it is out of range for now. The number is how many.
aura_blocked.use: Open the Quest Log (L) to see why.

aura_verified.title: Verified
aura_verified.body: A buff. Every quest here has passed the checker.
aura_verified.use: Nothing to do; this is the good ending.

aura_lease.title: Holding a lock
aura_lease.body: A buff. A helper has reserved something so nobody else changes it at the same time. The number is how many are held.
aura_lease.use: A lock is let go when its time runs out.

idea_goal.title: The goal
idea_goal.body: One or two sentences on what this project is for. vanilla-agents checks work against this, not only against the tests.
idea_goal.use: Open the file to change it: IDEA.md in the project's folder under the work folder.

idea_non_goals.title: Not building
idea_non_goals.body: Things this project should not do. Work that drifts into these is a sign something went off track.

idea_done_means.title: Done means
idea_done_means.body: What must be true for the project to count as finished.

idea_out_of_scope.title: Hands off
idea_out_of_scope.body: Files or folders agents should not change. If a change touches one, the checker runs the full route and notes an intent check in the chat log.

idea_approved.title: Idea approved
idea_approved.body: You approved this exact text. It is on record in the chat log.

idea_unapproved.title: Draft
idea_unapproved.body: The program wrote this from the project's own docs. It is only a draft until you approve it.
idea_unapproved.use: Read it, fix IDEA.md if needed, then click Approve the Idea.

idea_changed.title: Idea changed
idea_changed.body: The text is not what you approved. Someone edited IDEA.md.
idea_changed.use: Read it again, then approve it if it is right.

idea_approve.title: Approve the Idea
idea_approve.body: Records that this goal, these limits and this definition of done are right. It goes in the chat log and the plan's items appear in the quest log.

quest_details.title: Technical details
quest_details.use: This is the original wording from the project's notes.

quest_needs_plain.title: Needs plain words
quest_needs_plain.body: This quest still uses technical words. Add a plain sentence for it in the project's quests.json, or add the word to the glossary.
quest_needs_plain.use: Ask Claude to fill it in.

idea_needs_plain.title: Quests that need plain words
idea_needs_plain.body: These quests still use technical words nobody explained. Ask Claude to write plain sentences for them (project quests.json) or add the words to glossary.json.

idea_draft.title: Draft the Idea
idea_draft.body: Writes a first draft from the project's README and notes. No guessing by a model; it only copies headings and lists.

jukebox.title: The jukebox
jukebox.body: The workshop's music box. It plays the game's own music from where it stands, and its lights and lightning dance to the beat.
jukebox.use: Click it (or press J) to play or pause. Press K for the next song.

monitor_agents.title: Builder engine load
monitor_agents.body: How many helpers are working right now, out of all helpers in the inn.

monitor_feed.title: Environment sync
monitor_feed.body: LIVE while the window receives events from your Claude sessions; OFFLINE when the connection to the program dropped. The small number is seconds since the last event.

monitor_checker.title: Status
monitor_checker.body: What the checker is doing: ON = ready, CHECKING = a check is running, PAUSED = you paused it.

char_xp.title: Experience
char_xp.body: Actions this helper took. Every 10 actions is one level, like experience in the game.

char_rate.title: Pass rate
char_rate.body: How many of this helper's finished quests passed the checker.

timeline.title: Task timeline
timeline.body: What this helper did before, what it is doing now, and the next quest waiting.

force_play.title: Force Play
force_play.body: Run the checker now on the current work, without waiting.

chat_filter.title: Filter
chat_filter.body: Show every line, or only the helpers, the system or the checker.

panel_close.title: Close
panel_close.body: Hide this window. Its hotkey opens it again.

hearth.title: Hearthstone
hearth.body: Calls everyone home: pauses the checker and whispers every helper to finish the step they are on, then stop and wait for you.
hearth.use: Click twice, or press 6 twice (the second one confirms). Resume with Pause.

gossip_portrait.title: Helper
gossip_portrait.body: The helper you are talking to. Its face, name and job.

gossip_greeting.title: What it says
gossip_greeting.body: The helper tells you in plain words what it is doing right now and how many checks pass.

gossip_work.title: What are you working on?
gossip_work.body: Its last few steps and the checks its quest must pass.

gossip_explain.title: Explain this quest
gossip_explain.body: Asks the helper to explain its quest in plain words before going on.
gossip_explain.use: Click to ask for an explanation.

gossip_change.title: I want something changed
gossip_change.body: Tell the helper what should be different about its quest.
gossip_change.use: Click, type what you want, then Send.

gossip_verify.title: Run the checks
gossip_verify.body: Asks the trusted checker to test the work now.

gossip_whisper.title: Whisper
gossip_whisper.body: A private message to this helper. It reads it at its next step.

gossip_thread.title: Whispers
gossip_thread.body: Your private messages with this helper, and messages you sent to everyone. Newest at the bottom.

chat_input.title: Chat line
chat_input.body: Type /w and a helper's name to whisper to it, or /p to talk to every helper.
chat_input.use: Press Enter to start typing, Enter again to send.

inspect_slot.title: Changed file
inspect_slot.body: One file that differs from the last commit. Its colour tells how big the change is: grey small, green medium, blue large, purple huge. The letter: M changed, A added, D deleted, ? new and not in git yet.

inspect_filter.title: One helper's gear
inspect_filter.body: Only the changed files this helper touched are listed.

inspect_show_all.title: Show all
inspect_show_all.body: List every changed file in the project again.

inspect_diff.title: The change
inspect_diff.body: Green lines were added, red lines were removed, grey lines are unchanged context. The numbers are line numbers in the old and new file.

replay_slider.title: Time machine
replay_slider.body: Every event the inn has seen, oldest on the left. The whole window shows the inn as it was right after the event you pick.
replay_slider.use: Drag to travel back in time.

replay_play.title: Play / pause
replay_play.body: Step through the events one after another, as if it were happening again.

replay_speed.title: Speed
replay_speed.body: How many events each step jumps: 1, 4 or 16.

replay_live.title: Back to live
replay_live.body: Stop looking at the past and show what is happening now. While you look at the past, live changes wait.

replay_when.title: When
replay_when.body: The time of the last chat line at the event you are looking at.

mail_button.title: Mailbox
mail_button.body: Letters from the checker, the innkeeper and your heroes. The number shows how many you have not read yet.

mail_letter.title: Letter
mail_letter.body: Click to read it. Letters you have not read yet glow.

mail_back.title: Back
mail_back.body: Go back to the list of letters.

mail_delete.title: Delete
mail_delete.body: Throw this letter away. It is only hidden in this browser; nothing in the project changes.

ach_player_title.title: Title
ach_player_title.body: The title of your newest achievement. Open the achievements window to see them all.

meter_tab_rate.title: Actions per minute
meter_tab_rate.body: How many actions each helper took per minute, counted over the last few minutes while this window was open in the browser.

meter_tab_total.title: Total actions
meter_tab_total.body: Every action each helper took since it sat down.

meter_tab_passed.title: Quests passed
meter_tab_passed.body: How many quests of each helper passed the checker, and how many were checked in all.

meter_tab_cost.title: Cost
meter_tab_cost.body: Each helper's session cost in dollars as Claude Code estimates it (list prices; your real bill can differ), and dollars per minute of session time. Needs the status line bridge (setup --statusline).

meter_tab_log.title: Combat log
meter_tab_log.body: The checker's lines and the helpers' tool lines from the chat, with the time each one happened.

party_host.title: Host a party
party_host.body: Opens a party hub on this PC (port 8940). Everyone with the invite link can join, see the shared plan and your helpers' names and what they do. Never your code or files.
party_host.use: Send the link to friends on the same network (or over a VPN like Tailscale).

party_join.title: Join a party
party_join.body: Joins a friend's party: your helpers walk around in their inn and theirs in yours, and you plan the work together.
party_join.use: Paste the link and press Join.

party_agree.title: Agree to the plan
party_agree.body: When everyone in the party agrees to the same version, the plan locks and the items are split fairly between you. Any change asks everyone again.
party_agree.use: Your part becomes quests in your quest log; you still approve them.

party_take.title: Take this item
party_take.body: Moves an item that nobody has started to you.
party_take.use: Only after the plan is agreed.

party_item.title: Plan item
party_item.body: Size decides how the work is split. Proposed by a person or by their Claude.

help_diag.title: Save diagnostics
help_diag.body: Writes a small text file to your Desktop that helps someone find a problem. Read it first; it holds no keys, code or quest text.
help_diag.use: Click, then attach the file when you ask for help.

gossip_follow.title: Follow me
gossip_follow.body: An idle helper walks after you around the inn until you say stop or it gets a job.
gossip_follow.use: Just for fun: it does not change the helper's work.

gossip_rest.title: Take a break
gossip_rest.body: An idle helper goes to sit down for a minute and a half.
gossip_rest.use: Only in the inn; Claude itself is not paused (use Hearth for that).

gossip_wake.title: Are you still there?
gossip_wake.body: Whispers the helper to answer when it can. Useful for a helper that went quiet (a ghost).
gossip_wake.use: The answer comes back as a pink whisper.

party_reach.title: Who can join
party_reach.body: Only this PC: the hub listens on 127.0.0.1, nobody else can reach it (for trying it out). My network: friends on your Wi-Fi or VPN can join with the link.

party_renew.title: New invite link
party_renew.body: Makes a new invite link. The old link stops working; people already in the party stay in.

party_kick.title: Remove from the party
party_kick.body: Takes this person out of the party. Their key stops working, their unstarted items go back to the plan, and the invite link is renewed so the old one cannot bring them back.

chat_search.title: Search the chat
chat_search.body: Shows only the lines that contain these words (any case) and marks them.

zones_travel.title: Travel here
zones_travel.body: Moves your inn to this building. The window reloads with its music, light and picture; your helpers walk in again.

zones_remember.title: A zone for each project
zones_remember.body: When this is ticked, opening this project later takes you straight to this inn, so every project gets its own themed room.

zones_photo.title: Inside the inn
zones_photo.body: A picture taken the first time you opened this inn. It stays on your PC, in your assets folder (places/photos).

zones_tour.title: Picture tour
zones_tour.body: Visits every inn that has no picture yet, takes one of the inside and brings you back here. It takes a few seconds per inn; the pictures stay on your PC.

chat_tab_general.title: General
chat_tab_general.body: Everything that happens: your helpers, the checker and the system, and your whispers.

chat_tab_community.title: Community
chat_tab_community.body: Chat with the other people in your party. Only people read this tab: it never goes to Claude or any helper.
chat_tab_community.use: Click to open. Type here, or /c message from any tab.

chat_community_delete.title: Delete message
chat_community_delete.body: Only the host can do this. The message disappears for everyone in the party.

guide_search.title: Search the guide
guide_search.body: Type a word, like quest, pause or party. Only topics with that word stay in the list.
guide_search.use: Esc in the box clears it.

guide_open.title: Open it
guide_open.body: Opens the window this topic is about, so you can try it right away.

guide_setting.title: Show in Options
guide_setting.body: Opens the Options window at this setting and marks it.

help_guide.title: Feature guide
help_guide.body: Every feature of Vanilla Agents and how to use it, in plain words, with a search box.

esc_guide.title: Guide
esc_guide.body: Every feature of Vanilla Agents and how to use it, in plain words.

settings_guide.title: What do these settings do?
settings_guide.body: Opens the guide at the Settings chapter: every option, what it does and when to change it.

setting_VA_Building.title: Building
setting_VA_Building.body: Where your helpers work. Each building has its own furniture, music and look. Changing it reloads the page.
setting_VA_Building.use: Change it when you want a different place to work in.

setting_VA_TimeOfDay.title: Time of day
setting_VA_TimeOfDay.body: The light in the building. Auto follows your clock.
setting_VA_TimeOfDay.use: Pick day, dusk or night to keep one look all the time.

setting_VA_Music.title: Building music
setting_VA_Music.body: On: the jukebox plays music that fits the building. Off: it plays every song you baked.
setting_VA_Music.use: Turn it off for more variety.

setting_VA_Quality.title: Render quality
setting_VA_Quality.body: How sharp the inn is drawn. Lower is smoother on slow PCs; High adds smooth edges.
setting_VA_Quality.use: Lower it when the inn feels slow or jerky.

setting_VA_FpsCap.title: Frame rate cap
setting_VA_FpsCap.body: The most pictures per second the inn draws. A cap saves battery and keeps fans quiet.
setting_VA_FpsCap.use: Pick 30 on a laptop, no cap for the smoothest picture.

setting_VA_MaxHelpers.title: Helpers in the building
setting_VA_MaxHelpers.body: How many helpers walk around in the inn. Everyone still shows in the raid frames.
setting_VA_MaxHelpers.use: Lower it when the inn is crowded or slow.

setting_VA_Bubbles.title: Speech bubbles
setting_VA_Bubbles.body: A bubble over each working helper in the inn: its quest, or what it is doing, with three dots that keep going while it works.
setting_VA_Bubbles.use: Turn it off for a calmer inn, or when many helpers crowd the screen.

setting_VA_ReducedMotion.title: Reduce motion
setting_VA_ReducedMotion.body: Stops emotes, sparks, camera sway, errands and the pulsing raid frame. Starts out like your system setting.
setting_VA_ReducedMotion.use: Turn it on if movement on screen bothers you.

setting_character.title: Choose Character
setting_character.body: Pick the hero you walk around as in the inn. Only the 3D inn uses it.
setting_character.use: Change it whenever you like; it is remembered.

setting_sound.title: Sound
setting_sound.body: Master volume, mute, and which sound plays for each event, each with its own volume and a Test button.
setting_sound.use: Open it when a sound is too loud or you want a different one.

setting_game.title: A World of Warcraft option
setting_game.body: This option comes from the game itself and is kept for the look. It is saved, but Vanilla Agents does not use it.

setting_game_sound.title: Sound (used by Vanilla Agents)
setting_game_sound.body: This game option is wired to the window: it changes the volume or switches all sounds on or off.
setting_game_sound.use: Same as the master volume and mute in the Sound window.

setting_sound_master.title: Master volume and mute
setting_sound_master.body: How loud every sound is. Mute everything silences the window.
setting_sound_master.use: Turn it down if the sounds are too loud.

setting_sound_helpers.title: Helpers (extra Claude workers)
setting_sound_helpers.body: Kept for starting extra Claude workers from the window. This version does not start any, so it changes nothing yet.

setting_sound_event.title: Sound for this event
setting_sound_event.body: Pick the sound, its volume and whether it plays. Test plays it once.
setting_sound_event.use: Switch off the ones you do not want to hear.

gossip_resurrect.title: Resurrect
gossip_resurrect.body: Opens a new terminal on this PC running Claude Code with this helper's own conversation (claude --resume), in the folder it worked in. Only you can do this; helpers cannot.
gossip_resurrect.use: The helper wakes up in the inn when the session answers.

gossip_resurrect_cmd.title: Command to type
gossip_resurrect_cmd.body: No terminal could be opened from here. Open a terminal yourself and type this line; it goes to the helper's folder and resumes its conversation.

raid_menu_talk.title: Talk
raid_menu_talk.body: Opens the talk window for this helper.

raid_resurrect.title: Resurrect
raid_resurrect.body: Opens a new terminal running this helper's Claude session again (claude --resume) in the folder it worked in. Greyed out when the session id is not known.
raid_resurrect.use: Watch for the golden light in the inn.

raid_left.title: Went home
raid_left.body: This helper's Claude session ended. It stays here for a while so you can bring it back.

inspect_place.title: Branch and worktree
inspect_place.body: The git branch this helper works on. A worktree is a second copy of the project folder with its own branch: helpers in different worktrees never touch each other's files.

meter_tab_tokens.title: Tokens
meter_tab_tokens.body: How many tokens each helper wrote per minute lately (Claude's answers and code), counted from Claude Code's own session files on this PC.

help_phone_open.title: Phone link
help_phone_open.body: Opens Options > Phone: switch on Phone access and scan the QR code with your phone.

help_notify_open.title: Notifications
help_notify_open.body: Opens Options > Notifications: Discord, Slack, ntfy or a webhook.

phonelink_toggle.title: Phone access
phonelink_toggle.body: Off: only this PC can open the window. On: devices on your home network can open the phone page, but only with the secret link below; without it they see nothing.
phonelink_toggle.use: Switch it off again when you are done.

phonelink_qr.title: Phone link (QR code)
phonelink_qr.body: Point your phone's camera at it to open the phone page with your key. Anyone who scans it can approve, pause and run checks.

phonelink_link.title: Phone link
phonelink_link.body: The address of the phone page with your secret key at the end. Do not post it anywhere.

browserlink_toggle.title: Browser access
browserlink_toggle.body: On: this PC keeps one connection open to the Open Vanilla relay, so the browsers you pair can see the inn from anywhere. Nothing on this PC listens for the internet.
browserlink_toggle.use: Switch it off and every paired browser goes dark at once.

browserlink_qr.title: Pairing link
browserlink_qr.body: Open it in the browser you want to pair. It works once, for a few minutes, and only carries a one-time secret in the part of the address that browsers never send to servers.

browserlink_claude.title: Claude connector address
browserlink_claude.body: Paste it into Claude as a custom connector. That Claude can then add quests and report progress to your inn, but it can never approve, verify or pause.

notifyhub_discord.title: Discord
notifyhub_discord.body: Posts the message in a Discord channel through a webhook link you make in the channel's settings.

notifyhub_slack.title: Slack
notifyhub_slack.body: Posts the message in Slack through an incoming webhook link.

notifyhub_ntfy.title: ntfy
notifyhub_ntfy.body: Sends a push message to the ntfy app on your phone. Anyone who knows the topic name can read it, so make it hard to guess.

notifyhub_webhook.title: Webhook
notifyhub_webhook.body: Sends a small JSON message to any address you give, for your own tools.

notifyhub_events.title: What to tell you
notifyhub_events.body: Tick the moments this channel should tell you about. The same message is sent at most once a minute.

notifyhub_test.title: Send test
notifyhub_test.body: Sends one test message now with what is filled in above (saved or not).

notifyhub_save.title: Save
notifyhub_save.body: Keeps these settings in your own settings file on this PC. Sending starts at once.

chatreply_discord.title: Replies from Discord
chatreply_discord.body: Vanilla Agents reads this Discord channel with your bot every few seconds and acts on messages from the people on your allow list.
chatreply_discord.use: Use: type @Name message, /p message or status in the channel.

chatreply_slack.title: Replies from Slack
chatreply_slack.body: Vanilla Agents reads this Slack channel with your app's bot token every few seconds and acts on messages from the people on your allow list.
chatreply_slack.use: Use: type @Name message, /p message or status in the channel.

chatreply_ntfy.title: Replies from ntfy
chatreply_ntfy.body: Vanilla Agents reads this ntfy topic every few seconds. Only messages that start with your passphrase and a colon count; replies are posted to the same topic.
chatreply_ntfy.use: Use: send pw123: status from the ntfy app.

chatreply_token.title: Bot token
chatreply_token.body: The bot's secret. It is kept in your settings file on this PC, sent only to Discord or Slack, and never shown here again in full. Leave the field empty to keep the saved one.

chatreply_channel.title: Channel id
chatreply_channel.body: Which channel is read and answered. Only this one channel.

chatreply_allow.title: Who may command
chatreply_allow.body: User ids whose messages are obeyed. Everyone else in the channel is ignored and only counted in the status line.

chatreply_passphrase.title: Passphrase
chatreply_passphrase.body: ntfy has no accounts, so a command must start with this word and a colon. Anyone who knows the topic can read the replies, so pick a hard-to-guess topic too.

chatreply_poll.title: Read every
chatreply_poll.body: How often the channel is read, from 5 to 120 seconds. When the service asks to slow down, Vanilla Agents waits as long as it says.

chatreply_pause.title: Allow pause / resume
chatreply_pause.body: Lets the people on your allow list pause and resume the checker from chat. Off unless you tick it. Approving is never possible from chat.

chatreply_test.title: Test
chatreply_test.body: Reads the channel once with what is typed here and posts a short hello there. Nothing is saved.

chatreply_forget.title: Forget
chatreply_forget.body: Removes the saved secret from your settings file when you press Save.

chatreply_save.title: Save
chatreply_save.body: Keeps these settings in your own settings file. A switched-on service starts listening right away, from now on (older messages are never acted on).

chatreply_status.title: Status
chatreply_status.body: Where it listens, when the last command came, how many messages from other people were ignored, and the last problem in plain words.

contest_item.title: The quest up for grabs
contest_item.body: Several helpers each made their own fix for this quest. Compare them here and pick one, like rolling for loot in a group.
contest_item.use: The colour is the quest's size.

contest_row.title: One helper's fix
contest_row.body: Who made it, what they say it does, how many files and lines it changes, and what the checker said about it.

contest_check.title: Check this one
contest_check.body: Runs the project's checks on this helper's branch (its last saved commit), the same checks Verify runs. Your own quest log and run history stay as they are.
contest_check.use: One check at a time; uncommitted work in their folder is not included.

contest_show.title: Show changes
contest_show.body: Opens the Inspect window with what this helper's branch changed since it left the base branch. Nothing is changed by looking.

contest_need.title: Need
contest_need.body: Pick this fix as the winner. The helper is told to merge it into the base branch, the others are thanked, and the competition ends.
contest_need.use: Only you can pick; helpers cannot.

contest_pass.title: Pass
contest_pass.body: Hide this fix from the list for now. Nothing is sent to the helper.

contest_stop.title: Stop competing
contest_stop.body: End the competition without picking a fix. The quest goes on as a normal quest.

contest_log.title: The roll
contest_log.body: Just for fun: the numbers are dice like in a group loot roll, and your pick always rolls highest. The pick itself is your choice, not luck.

quest_compete.title: Let several helpers try
quest_compete.body: Let 2 to 4 helpers each make their own fix for this quest on their own branch. You compare them in the Need or Greed window and pick the best one.

quest_compete_roll.title: Roll for the winner
quest_compete_roll.body: Opens the Need or Greed window with every fix sent for this quest.

integ_github.title: Import from GitHub
integ_github.body: Shows this project's open GitHub issues and pull requests as bounties on the Bounty Board, refreshed every few minutes, and its latest CI runs in the quest log. Nothing becomes a quest by itself.

integ_mode.title: Sign in with
integ_mode.body: The gh command uses the sign-in you already made with gh auth login, so no token is stored here. A token is for PCs without gh.

integ_token.title: GitHub token
integ_token.body: A fine-grained personal access token with read-only access to issues, pull requests and actions. Kept in your settings file, sent only to GitHub, never shown again in full.

integ_labels.title: Only these labels
integ_labels.body: Import only open issues with one of these labels (up to 5, separated by commas). Empty imports every open issue.

integ_prs.title: Pull requests
integ_prs.body: Which open pull requests to bring in: the ones waiting for your review, assigned to you, opened by you, or all of them.

integ_host.title: Enterprise host
integ_host.body: Only for GitHub Enterprise Server whose name does not contain github, e.g. git.mycompany.com. Leave empty for github.com.

integ_minutes.title: Refresh every
integ_minutes.body: How often switched-on imports look for new and closed items (1 to 1440 minutes). CI is looked at every 2 minutes.

integ_refresh.title: Refresh now
integ_refresh.body: Looks for new and closed items right away. Closed ones leave the Bounty Board; quests already made from them stay.

integ_test.title: Test
integ_test.body: Signs in with what is typed here and says who you are. Imports nothing and saves nothing.

integ_import.title: Import from file
integ_import.body: Pick a CSV export from Jira or Linear. Open rows become bounties; finished rows are skipped. A new file from the same tool replaces the last one.

integ_linear.title: Linear by API key
integ_linear.body: Optional: fetches your open Linear issues every few minutes with a personal API key, instead of importing a file by hand.

integ_jira.title: Jira Cloud by API token
integ_jira.body: Optional: fetches open Jira issues every few minutes with your e-mail and an API token from id.atlassian.com.

integ_forget.title: Forget
integ_forget.body: Removes the saved token or key from your settings file when you press Save.

integ_save.title: Save
integ_save.body: Keeps these settings in your own settings file on this PC. Switched-on imports start within a minute.

auction_source.title: Where it comes from
auction_source.body: Show bounties from every source, or only from GitHub, Jira or Linear.

auction_link.title: Open link
auction_link.body: Opens the issue or pull request on its own site, in your browser.

auction_make.title: Make it a quest
auction_make.body: Turns this proposal into a normal quest in the quest log, with the link in its why. You still approve it there as usual before a helper may finish it.

auction_hide.title: Hide
auction_hide.body: Takes this proposal off the board for good. Nothing changes on GitHub, Jira or Linear.

auction_imported.title: Imported proposal
auction_imported.body: Work found on GitHub, Jira or Linear. Helpers cannot see or take it until you make it a quest.

auction_settings.title: Integrations
auction_settings.body: Opens Options > Integrations: switch GitHub on, import a Jira or Linear file.

quest_ci.title: CI
quest_ci.body: The latest GitHub Actions runs of this branch, for information. The quest is still checked by your own checker; a red CI line is a hint to look, not a block.

monitor_ci.title: CI
monitor_ci.body: GitHub Actions on this branch: PASSED, FAILED, RUNNING. Read-only; shown when GitHub import is on and the project has workflows.

addons_install.title: Install from .zip
addons_install.body: Pick an addon zip from your PC. It is checked before anything is written and starts switched off.
addons_install.use: Only install addons from people you trust: an addon can do anything the window can.

addons_browse.title: Browse the Workshop
addons_browse.body: Lists the Vanilla Agents addons in the Open Vanilla Workshop. This is the only time addons go online, and only when you click.

addons_reload.title: Reload window
addons_reload.body: Starts the window again so enabled addons load and disabled ones stop.

addons_toggle.title: Enabled
addons_toggle.body: Whether this addon starts with the window. The change takes effect after Reload window.

addons_remove.title: Remove
addons_remove.body: Moves the addon to the .removed folder inside the addons folder. Nothing is deleted; move it back to restore it.

addons_package.title: Package for the Workshop
addons_package.body: Makes <id>-<version>.zip and a catalogue entry <id>.yml in the addons/.packages folder, ready to send to the Open Vanilla Workshop.

addons_replace.title: Replace
addons_replace.body: Puts the new addon in place of the installed one with the same id. The old one is moved to the .removed folder.

addons_trust.title: Addons are trusted code
addons_trust.body: Permissions are what an addon says about itself, so you can decide. They are not a lock: every addon runs with the window's full power.

setting_addons.title: AddOns
setting_addons.body: Opens the AddOns window: your own scripts that run in this window. Switch them on or off, install, remove or package them for the Workshop.
setting_addons.use: Open it to add a sign or helper script, or to switch one off that misbehaves.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.body: Goes to the next helper with a gold "!": one waiting for your OK, a question or something to type. Its talk window opens so you can answer. The number shows how many are waiting.
needs.use: Click or press 3. Press again for the next one.

quests.title: Quest log
quests.body: Opens or closes the quest log: every quest, what it needs from you, and Approve.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: Opens or closes Inspect: the files your helpers changed, with every line added and removed.
